state:
**Goal `var-array-literal` — `var` infers an array literal whose elements all have one type — has just started; nothing of it has landed yet.** Goal `foreach-var`'s whole list is this goal's Stage 1 floor.

The design is settled and is the user's, in one sentence: an array literal under `var` is
`array<T>` when every element has the same type, and otherwise it is refused with a help line
naming the type to write. The goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session
meets, and no session re-decides one.

Two facts about the tree as the goal was written. The refusal is one `matches!` in the `var` arm of
`crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs`, so the checker half is small. The synthesis that
`rule:ide/no-compile-path-calls-the-synthesis` describes is **designed and not built** — no crate
holds it — so Stage 2 writes it rather than calling it.

items.text: **The decision record** — one new record, written first, from the goal's § *Standing decisions*; it `modifies` `types/var-inference`, `types/arrays` and `ide/no-compile-path-calls-the-synthesis`, and the three fragments are rewritten whole with it.

**The synthesis** — one function beside `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/literals.rs:@check_array_literal`: `array<T>` when every element has one interned type, nested literals first, spreads by their element type; otherwise the reason, with the canonical union for the help line.

**The `var` arm calls it** — `crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs`'s `None` arm: on success the literal is checked against `array<T>` and the binding declared at it; on refusal `E_VAR_ARRAY_LITERAL_NEEDS_TYPE` with a message per case and a help line naming the written declaration.

**The `foreach` subject follows** — `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/iteration.rs`: a bare literal subject under a `var` binding goes through the same function. Goal `foreach-var`'s two refusing checks keep their names; their literal becomes one whose elements differ.

**The two conformance cases and the named tests** of the goal file's Stage 2 checks; `tests/conformance/lang/var-refuses-a-bare-array-literal.nvst` is folded into the refusing case and deleted, and the two rule records that list it name the new cases.

backlog: **Stage 3: the later write, the editor and the lowering** — the help line on a write that misses an inferred element type, `crates/nvs-lsp/src/hints.rs`'s inlay hint, and the IR-equality test in `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/tests.rs`. Shares no file with Stage 2 beyond `nvs-types`, so it is its own session.

**Stage 4: the feature proofs, and everything already on disk** — the new example and attack step, then the documents Stage 0 lists, the two features' `about.md` and examples, the regenerated `docs/novis.md`, and the closing search. Prose and programs only; no crate is open.
When this goal's last check goes green the driver takes goal `ci-green`.
